The '''Juran Mountains''' was a majestic site on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that had seen many conflicts since the [[Great Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Alderaan]], it became a refuge for [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] resistance fighters who used the natural cover to evade the invading [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] forces. At one point during that conflict, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jace Malcom]] of [[Havoc Squad]], assisted by [[Satele Shan]], ambushed the forces of [[Darth Malgus]]. This led to the [[Republic trooper]]'s victory over the powerful [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Juran Mountains}}</ref>

Despite a few short [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of peace, the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] had once again became the site of aggressive violent actions. By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[House Ulgo]], backed by its vassals in [[House Rist]], occupied the Juran Mountains where they were involved a brutal conflict with the forces of both [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] and [[House of Thul|House Thul]].<ref name="TORC" />
